purpose: Close the continuum-construction tooling gap with a theorem-calibrated Powers/ITPFI control without identifying it with physical de Sitter.

construction.limit: quasi-local inductive-limit C*-algebra followed by the GNS representation of the infinite product state and von Neumann closure
construction.modular_core: algebraic union of finite cylinder algebras; local matrix units are entire analytic

source_anchor.citation: H. Araki and E. J. Woods, A Classification of Factors, Publ. RIMS Kyoto Univ. 4 (1968) 51-130, DOI 10.2977/prims/1195195263
source_anchor.fact: For tensor products of type-I factors, asymptotic ratio set {0, x^n; n in Z}, 0<x<1, is case (iv), type III; Powers examples belong to this case.

forbidden_inferences: do not identify the control factor with the physical de Sitter static-patch algebra
do not infer convergence of the existing finite m=2,3,4 regulator to the control
do not promote Type III_lambda control to Type III_1
do not infer gravity or crossed-product Type-II classification from this control
